newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft on dollar demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer at 476.75/477.75 on large dollar orders, traders said.
"All was quiet until this afternoon when two large corporate clients placed large dollar orders," said a broker at a bank that handled one of the trades.
The exchange rate softened to about 478 per dollar "until, just before the close, the Central Bank came in strong and firmed it up again to its closing price," he added.
The bolivar closed Thursday at 476.50/477.50 per dollar.
